svg.title: Ouro power board, 66 x 20.5 mm perfboard (link s5)
svg.text: Ouro power board: 66 x 20.5 mm pad-per-hole perfboard, 26 x 8 holes, on the s5 front block
Long side across the link (link y -33..+33), short side along the body (link x 19.0..39.5). 1 mm foam tape. Plain perfboard: no track cuts.
Holes are named column 1-26 + row A-H. Row A faces s4 (the ESP32), row H faces s6.
Mini560 stack, 18 mm side along the body
bottom: U3 (5 V for the ESP32)
top: U1 (5 V servos), 1 mm foam between
U1 IN+ and U3 IN+ legs (both in one hole)
R2 33k standing, C3 100 nF beside it
U1 GND and U3 GND legs
LATCH tie: H1 white + H2 white
J1 rows A-H: S / +5V / GND = servo 1..8
U1 OUT+ pad (top buck) -> U2 VIN+ pad
VCC SCL SDA GND: H1 + H2 wires (2 per pad)
BOTTOM (solder side, flipped left-right: column 1 is on the RIGHT)
Bottom traces (bare tinned 20-22 AWG soldered at every hole for power runs)
black: 1F-1G-1H; row F 1-13; 13C-13F; row H 1-22; column 26 A-H
dashed: JB1 22G -> 25G and JB2 22H -> 26H, 24 AWG INSULATED (they cross 23-25)
